reason: AIMNet search finished while two slower search owners remain. Release idle CPU capacity before starting any specialization training; preserve frozen labels, seeds, optimizer, update budgets and checkpoint selection.
dispatch_rule: floor((12 - 3 * active_searches) / 4), clamped to [0,3]. Missing search state reserves threads; failed search or twelve-hour waiting deadline blocks new dispatch. Existing training drains without being killed.
wall_time_comparison: Record concurrency and actual wall time; equal-update systems do not imply equal wall time or FLOPs.
